nodes.label: ArcSonare
nodes.rationale: Voice-first AI operating environment for Windows; Phase 3 evolves it from a settings-only utility into a full desktop Command Center.

nodes.label: Command Center (main window)
nodes.rationale: Single main native window hosting Dashboard, Tasks, Agent, Connect and Settings pages; Settings is a page inside main rather than a separate window so all entry points (header gear, tray, quick menu) navigate to one surface.

nodes.label: Global Shortcut Routing
nodes.rationale: When the main window is visible AND focused, the global shortcut toggles the in-app voice console via the sonare:voice-toggle event; otherwise it toggles the top-screen overlay. This keeps one shortcut serving two surfaces without conflict.

nodes.label: Show/Hide-Never-Destroy Window Pattern
nodes.rationale: Windows are only ever shown/hidden, never destroyed; closing the main window (red traffic light, Alt+F4) hides ArcSonare to the tray, and only 'Quit ArcSonare' exits. Preserves window state and enables instant re-show.

nodes.label: Simulated Voice States
nodes.rationale: No real microphone, AI model, or OAuth integration is connected in Phase 3; voice states (listening -> processing -> speaking) are a clearly-local simulation and integrations honestly show 'Not connected / Coming soon' to avoid implying capability that does not exist.

nodes.label: Rust Native Layer
nodes.rationale: Rust owns all native behavior: global shortcut (register-new-before-unregister-old ordering), settings persistence in %APPDATA%\com.arcsonare.desktop, autostart, monitor-aware positioning, tray, and window show/hide commands in panels.rs.

nodes.label: React + TypeScript Frontend
nodes.rationale: React + TypeScript renders the four windows routed by window label in App.tsx; main-window state lives in small useSyncExternalStore stores under src/stores/.

nodes.label: Smoked Titanium Design Language
nodes.rationale: Design tokens in src/styles/tokens.css: graphite surfaces with a restrained violet AI accent, shared across all windows/surfaces for visual consistency.

nodes.label: Orbital ArcSonare Logo
nodes.rationale: The orbital mark lives in src/components/brand/ArcSonareLogo.tsx and was the source from which the app icons in src-tauri/icons were generated.

nodes.label: Icon Registry (iconRegistry.ts)
nodes.rationale: Icon mapping in src/config/iconRegistry.ts; integration logos were extracted from the local ICO/ library (highest-resolution PNG frame) into src/assets/icons/integrations/ and keep their brand colors. Asana and Microsoft Calendar are absent because the ICO library lacks those icons.

nodes.label: Demo Data (demoData.ts)
nodes.rationale: Up Next events, Focus card, agents and connected tools are demo data from src/data/demoData.ts; tasks marked 'Demo' were seeded once.
